main_text.l: elegerunt quietam in timore Dei vitam de-gere,id Deo gratissimum fore meminerint si ex juventute, quos aptos sacro huic muneri noverunt, exhortentur & suscitent, ut in amplissimam hanc Christi vineam ingressi eorum bonorum se reddant participes, quæ Dominus nomen suum diligentibus promisit.

page.notes: The first word of the page, "elegerunt", is a fragment continued from the previous page. The "de-" at the end of line 1 is cut off by the scan edge, so the hyphen is uncertain. The "si" at the start of line 3 is printed as a long-s-like form and may be "fi"; it is read here as "si". The display letters "DE" and "E" at the right are large printed type that opens a section below the visible text; they are not part of the running text. Below "promisit." the text is faint show-through from the reverse side and is omitted.
